title: Cold-Start Personalization via Bayesian Adaptive Questioning
abstract: arXiv:2602.15012v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cold-start personalization requires inferring preferences from minimal interaction when no user-specific historical data is available. The space of possible preferences is vast, yet users care about only a sparse subset and rarely articulate them upfront; combined with limited interaction budgets, this makes preference elicitation challenging. Our key insight is that preferences exhibit predictable structure across populations; e.g., users who want detailed explanations often also value worked examples. We propose CAPE (Cold-start Adaptive Preference Elicitation), which learns a structured world model of preference correlations offline from complete profiles, then performs training-free Bayesian inference online to select informative questions and predict complete preference profiles, including dimensions never asked about. Even simple belief model instantiations (e.g., linear regression) substantially outperform end-to-end RL.

translated_title: 基于贝叶斯自适应提问的冷启动个性化
translated_abstract: 冷启动个性化需要在没有用户特定历史数据可用的情况下，仅通过极少量的交互来推断用户偏好。可能的偏好空间非常庞大，但用户只关心其中稀疏的子集，且很少会主动明确表达这些偏好；再加上有限的交互预算，这使得偏好引出（elicitation）变得极具挑战性。我们的关键洞察是：偏好在不同用户群体之间表现出可预测的结构；例如，希望获得详细解释的用户通常也重视完整的示例演算。我们提出了CAPE（冷启动自适应偏好引出，Cold-start Adaptive Preference Elicitation），该方法先离线地从完整用户画像中学习一个关于偏好相关性的结构化世界模型，然后在线执行无需训练的贝叶斯推断，以选择信息量最大的问题并预测完整的偏好画像，甚至包括从未询问过的维度。即使是简单的信念模型实例（如线性回归），其表现也能大幅超越端到端的强化学习方法。
tldr: 提出CAPE方法，先离线从完整用户画像中学习偏好相关性的结构化世界模型，再在线通过免训练的贝叶斯推断选择信息量最大的问题并预测完整偏好画像，即使使用简单的线性回归信念模型也能大幅超越端到端强化学习。
en_tdlr: CAPE learns an offline structured world model of preference correlations and applies training-free Bayesian inference online to ask informative questions, achieving cold-start personalization that substantially outperforms end-to-end RL even with simple linear belief models.
